about-intro:
Aasee is a full-stack builder with Java, Python, and Go backend plus AI application engineering experience.
Focuses on LLM and business-system integration, MCP tools, Agent Runtime, local-first products, and Web3 protocol practice. Main open-source projects include Open-WebSearch and Musio.
